parent_v5.key_result: directionality reduced source aliasing and increased robust-impossibility recovery, while temporal evidence further reduced world/source identity without increasing full-coverage robust-impossibility recovery

scientific_question: As the declared virtual-world universe is expanded while the occurrence evidence is held fixed, which universal relation certificates persist, and is robust impossibility more persistent than robust reachability?

latent_landscapes.reuse: the exact 384 v5 directed-flow latent rows, A/B fields, geographic neighbourhoods, barrier draws, analyst rules, outlet flow field and truth source
latent_landscapes.eligibility: reuse the v5 eligibility condition of at least four non-source truth-reachable nodes
latent_landscapes.evidence: 25 percent dispersed-farthest-first truth-positive occurrence coverage, using the already frozen v4 sampling rule; source identity remains unobserved

nested_candidate_universes.U0_source_only: every A/B-permissive candidate source under the truth row's barrier-density level and relative_edge_q70 analyst rule
nested_candidate_universes.U1_plus_barrier: every candidate source x all three frozen barrier levels under relative_edge_q70
nested_candidate_universes.U2_plus_analyst: every candidate source x all three barrier levels x all three frozen analyst environmental rules
nested_candidate_universes.nesting: U0 subset U1 subset U2 exactly

world_compatibility: a candidate directed world survives when every frozen 25 percent dispersed positive anchor is reachable from that candidate source

node_status_within_survivors.robust_reachable: node reachable from the candidate source in every surviving world
node_status_within_survivors.contingent: node reachable in some but not all surviving worlds
node_status_within_survivors.robust_impossible: node unreachable in every surviving world

certificate_population: all locally A/B-permissive nodes excluding the frozen observed 25 percent positive anchors and the truth source; this retains both unobserved truth-reachable and truth-unreachable nodes for certificate comparison
primary_outputs: survivor-world count at U0, U1 and U2
surviving-source count at U0, U1 and U2
robust-reachable, contingent and robust-impossible node counts at each universe
U0 robust-reachable certificate retention in U1 and U2
U0 robust-impossible certificate retention in U1 and U2
certificate losses caused by barrier-world expansion
additional certificate losses caused by analyst-world expansion

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every eligible row, each U0 robust-reachable or robust-impossible certificate either persists or becomes contingent as the universe expands; no node contingent at a smaller universe may become newly robust-reachable or newly robust-impossible solely because worlds are added.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row loses at least one U0 universal certificate when expanding from U0 to U1.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if barrier-world expansion never changes any U0 universal node status.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row loses at least one universal certificate when expanding from U1 to U2.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if analyst-world expansion never changes any U1 universal node status.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across all eligible U0 node certificates, pooled retention from U0 to U2 is strictly larger for robust-impossible certificates than for robust-reachable certificates.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if impossible-certificate retention minus reachable-certificate retention is <=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: The pooled U2 result contains at least one robust-reachable and at least one robust-impossible unobserved locally-permissive node.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if either universal category is globally empty at U2.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At every nested universe, no truth-reachable node is classified robust-impossible and no truth-unreachable node is classified robust-reachable.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any false universal certificate is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Pooled mean contingent-node fraction is strictly larger at U2 than at U0.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if U2-minus-U0 pooled mean contingent fraction is <=0.

secondary_outputs: certificate persistence by environmental autocorrelation, neighbourhood and truth barrier density
whether U0 certificate type predicts which uncertainty axis destroys it
relationship between truth DAG branching/redundancy and certificate persistence
rows with zero surviving universal statements after full expansion
claim_boundary: Certificate persistence is conditional on the frozen candidate-world expansion path.
Robust-impossible means unreachable in every surviving declared world, not universally impossible in nature.
Robust-reachable means reachable in every surviving declared world, not guaranteed demographic connectivity.
A favorable C4 would support only this generator-level asymmetry, not a universal theorem that impossibility is always more robust than possibility.
stop_rules: Do not change the nested universe definitions after scoring.
Do not add a fourth analyst rule or barrier level after scoring.
Do not remove nodes with inconvenient certificate behavior.
Do not redefine the certificate population after scoring.
If C4 is refuted, retain the refutation and do not search for a different expansion order.

preimplementation_amendment.reason: complete positive coverage would remove all unobserved truth-reachable nodes from the certificate population, making robust-reachable versus robust-impossible persistence incomparable
preimplementation_amendment.replacement_evidence: 25 percent dispersed-farthest-first positives using the already frozen v4 sampling design
